S.FORM: maedeng ca pakamotep, kiya kiya fangcalay, ko heci.
S.PHON: maə[ɬ|ɮ]əŋ ʦa pakam[o|u]təp kija kija faŋʦaɾaj k[o|u] ħəʦi
S.TRANSL: 差不多不到十個好的。
The good ones were less than ten.

S.FORM: falahantu isu.
S.PHON: faɾaħantu isu
S.FORM: falahanto iso.
S.PHON: faɾaħant[o|u] is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 你丟了嗎？
Did you throw them away?

S.FORM: ca'ayay maala ku panukay.
S.PHON: ʦaʡajaj maaɾa ku panukaj
S.FORM: ca'ayay maala ko panokay.
S.PHON: ʦaʡajaj maaɾa k[o|u] pan[o|u]kaj
S.TRANSL: 我沒有拿回來。
I didn't bring them back here.

S.FORM: XX, anuhoni, anu masama'antu anu mami, culu' kita tu 'amutu.
S.PHON: xx anuħoni anu masamaʡantu anu mami ʦuɾuʡ kita tu ʡamutu
S.FORM: XX, anohoni, ano masama'anto ano mami, colo' kita to 'amoto.
S.PHON: xx an[o|u]ħ[o|u]ni an[o|u] masamaʡant[o|u] an[o|u] mami ʦ[o|u]ɾ[o|u]ʡ kita t[o|u] ʡam[o|u]t[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 等一下看怎麼樣，我們要去運水泥時。

TRANSL.notes: (Let's see) later, when we go to carry the concrete.

S.TRANSL: later, when we go to carry the concrete.

S.FORM: hay, u ruma satu a sasuwalen aku, ura, putaw iraaw uya nipaluma'an.
S.PHON: ħaj u ruma satu a sasuwaɾən aku ura putaw iraaw uja nipaɾumaʡan
S.FORM: hay, o roma sato a sasowalen ako, ora, potaw iraaw oya nipaloma'an.
S.PHON: ħaj [o|u] r[o|u]ma sat[o|u] a sas[o|u]waɾən ak[o|u] [o|u]ra p[o|u]taw iraaw [o|u]ja nipaɾ[o|u]maʡan
S.TRANSL: 是的，其次我要說的是那裡種的葡萄。
Right. Another thing that I want to mention is the grapes that we planted.

S.FORM: munengawtu kuya, hiya ira ci, falu, XX, cicu'ongtu kuya, kuya putaw.
S.PHON: munəŋawtu kuja ħija ira ʦi faɾu xx ʦiʦuʡoŋtu kuja kuja putaw
S.FORM: monengawto koya, hiya ira ci, falo, XX, cico'ongto koya, koya potaw.
S.PHON: m[o|u]nəŋawt[o|u] k[o|u]ja ħija ira ʦi faɾ[o|u] xx ʦiʦ[o|u]ʡ[o|u]ŋt[o|u] k[o|u]ja k[o|u]ja p[o|u]taw

TRANSL.notes: 長出來了，開花（這裡語誤），出芽了，那個葡萄。

S.TRANSL: 長出來了，開花 ，出芽了，那個葡萄。
The grapes sprouted.

S.FORM: alahantu aku kuya, kuhtingay satahepu tuya, lukut.
S.PHON: aɾaħantu aku kuja kuħtiŋaj sataħəpu tuja ɾukut
S.FORM: alahanto ako koya, kohtingay satahepo toya, lokot.
S.PHON: aɾaħant[o|u] ak[o|u] k[o|u]ja k[o|u]ħtiŋaj sataħəp[o|u] t[o|u]ja ɾ[o|u]k[o|u]t
S.TRANSL: 我帶了覆蓋山蘇的黑布幔。
I took a piece of black cloth to cover the plant.

S.FORM: nga'ay, patu'urhantu ni, hiya tu, XX, u safang, saka ku kira.
S.PHON: ŋaʡaj patuʡurħantu ni ħija tu xx u safaŋ saka ku kira
S.FORM: nga'ay, pato'orhanto ni, hiya to, XX, o safang, saka ko kira.
S.PHON: ŋaʡaj pat[o|u]ʡ[o|u]rħant[o|u] ni ħija t[o|u] xx [o|u] safaŋ saka k[o|u] kira
S.TRANSL: 可以把它舖上作為網子，我這樣想。
We can do it this way. As a net, I think.

S.FORM: manga'aytu ira ku, safang itira i luma'.
S.PHON: maŋaʡajtu ira ku safaŋ itira i ɾumaʡ
S.FORM: manga'ayto ira ko, safang itira i loma'.
S.PHON: maŋaʡajt[o|u] ira k[o|u] safaŋ itira i ɾ[o|u]maʡ
S.TRANSL: 可以的話，家裡有網子。
There is a net at home.

S.FORM: anu, ca sapima'an ni lekal kuya safang, alaantu ka, patayni ta, sangaantu ita kura, rangra nura, putaw, sa ku falucu', aku.
S.PHON: anu ʦa sapimaʡan ni ɾəkaɾ kuja safaŋ aɾaantu ka patajni ta saŋaantu ita kura raŋra nura putaw sa ku faɾuʦuʡ aku
S.FORM: ano, ca sapima'an ni lekal koya safang, alaanto ka, patayni ta, sangaanto ita kora, rangra nora, potaw, sa ko faloco', ako.
S.PHON: an[o|u] ʦa sapimaʡan ni ɾəkaɾ k[o|u]ja safaŋ aɾaant[o|u] ka patajni ta saŋaant[o|u] ita k[o|u]ra raŋra n[o|u]ra p[o|u]taw sa k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 如果lekal沒有拿去幹麻的話。把它拿來，我們作葡萄的棚子，我這樣想。
If Lekal didn't take it, we'll use it as a shed for the grapes. That's what I think.

FORM.notes: IU191處發音人語誤講成mi-ala，其實應該是mi-‘aca購買才對。

S.FORM: ta u roma satu, icila mi, ala ci mayaw tura, suta' itira i, ni, kuocintien kyami.

S.FORM: ta o roma sato, icila mi, ala ci mayaw tora, sota' itira i, ni, koocintien kyami.
S.PHON: ta [o|u] r[o|u]ma sat[o|u] iʦiɾa mi aɾa ʦi majaw t[o|u]ra s[o|u]taʡ itira i ni k[o|u][o|u]ʦintiən kjami
S.TRANSL: 另外，上次mayaw買了地在郭金田那，不是嗎?
Didn't Mayaw purchase a piece of land there at Kuo Chintien's?

S.FORM: kala'enu na kasapad.
S.PHON: kaɾaʡənu na kasapaɬ
S.FORM: kala'eno na kasapad.
S.PHON: kaɾaʡən[o|u] na kasapa[ɬ|ɮ]
S.TRANSL: 在Kasapad他們的下面。
Below Kasapad's.

S.FORM: mmh, ma'ecitu aku ci, kuocintienan ku payci, tu ipan sa'an.
S.PHON: mmħ maʡəʦitu aku ʦi kuoʦintiənan ku pajʦi tu ipan saʡan
S.FORM: mmh, ma'ecito ako ci, koocintienan ko payci, to ipan sa'an.
S.PHON: mmħ maʡəʦit[o|u] ak[o|u] ʦi k[o|u][o|u]ʦintiənan k[o|u] pajʦi t[o|u] ipan saʡan
S.TRANSL: 我把錢寄給郭金田了，寄了一半。
I have sent money to Kuo Chintien, half of it.

S.FORM: anucila, maharektu kura siokencio ta, patayra haca kaku tu, payci.
S.PHON: anuʦiɾa maħarəktu kura siokənʦio ta patajra ħaʦa kaku tu pajʦi
S.FORM: anocila, maharekto kora siokencio ta, patayra haca kako to, payci.
S.PHON: an[o|u]ʦiɾa maħarəkt[o|u] k[o|u]ra si[o|u]kənʦi[o|u] ta patajra ħaʦa kak[o|u] t[o|u] pajʦi
S.TRANSL: 過幾天等到處理完所有權狀後，我還要再拿錢過去。
A few days later when the title deed is done, I will pay the balance.

S.FORM: latek minukay kami itiya, sa kira.
S.PHON: ɾatək minukaj kami itija sa kira
S.FORM: latek minokay kami itiya, sa kira.
S.PHON: ɾatək min[o|u]kaj kami itija sa kira
S.TRANSL: 可能我們那時候回來。
We will probably come back then.

S.FORM: sakapina a fulad kura, sapinukay nira.
S.PHON: sakapina a fuɾaɬ kura sapinukaj nira
S.FORM: sakapina a folad kora, sapinokay nira.
S.PHON: sakapina a f[o|u]ɾa[ɬ|ɮ] k[o|u]ra sapin[o|u]kaj nira
S.TRANSL: 她們大概是幾月回來？
In which month are they coming back?

S.FORM: XX, unini a fulad kiya.
S.PHON: xx unini a fuɾaɬ kija
S.FORM: XX, onini a folad kiya.
S.PHON: xx [o|u]nini a f[o|u]ɾa[ɬ|ɮ] kija
S.TRANSL: 就是這個月。
This month.

S.FORM: tuna sakaenem.
S.PHON: tuna sakaənəm
S.FORM: tona sakaenem.
S.PHON: t[o|u]na sakaənəm
S.TRANSL: 這個六月嗎？
This June?

S.FORM: hay, tuna sakaenem, sakalima ka.
S.PHON: ħaj tuna sakaənəm sakaɾima ka
S.FORM: hay, tona sakaenem, sakalima ka.
S.PHON: ħaj t[o|u]na sakaənəm sakaɾima ka
S.TRANSL: 是，這個六月，或是五月。
Right, this June, or probably May.

S.FORM: XX, sostala uya suwal isu icila, e anu matira, mama'acatu ni mayaw, kura suta'.
S.PHON: xx sostaɾa uja suwaɾ isu iʦiɾa ə anu matira mamaʡaʦatu ni majaw kura sutaʡ
S.FORM: XX, sostala oya sowal iso icila, e ano matira, mama'acato ni mayaw, kora sota'.
S.PHON: xx s[o|u]staɾa [o|u]ja s[o|u]waɾ is[o|u] iʦiɾa ə an[o|u] matira mamaʡaʦat[o|u] ni majaw k[o|u]ra s[o|u]taʡ
S.TRANSL: 所以你那次提過的，Mayaw買了那塊地後，...。
So last time you mentioned that Mayaw already bought that piece of land.

S.FORM: anu tayra sa kita mifunsia, sa kuya suwal isu.
S.PHON: anu tajra sa kita mifunsia sa kuja suwaɾ isu
S.FORM: ano tayra sa kita mifonsia, sa koya sowal iso.
S.PHON: an[o|u] tajra sa kita mif[o|u]nsia sa k[o|u]ja s[o|u]waɾ is[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 我們去噴藥，妳這樣說過。
We are going to spray pesticides. That is what you said.

S.FORM: anu fangcaltu ku, rumi'ad haw i, tayra satu kita mifunsia, sa kuna, niharatengantu aku.
S.PHON: anu faŋʦaɾtu ku rumiʡaɬ ħaw i tajra satu kita mifunsia sa kuna niħaratəŋantu aku
S.FORM: ano fangcalto ko, romi'ad haw i, tayra sato kita mifonsia, sa kona, niharatenganto ako.
S.PHON: an[o|u] faŋʦaɾt[o|u] k[o|u] r[o|u]miʡa[ɬ|ɮ] ħaw i tajra sat[o|u] kita mif[o|u]nsia sa k[o|u]na niħaratəŋant[o|u] ak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 看什麼時候天氣好，我們去噴藥，我是這樣子想。
When the weather is good, we'll go there to spray pesticides. That's what I think.

S.FORM: anu awa ku limaw isu, aka pacici maketeraw, ka'emangay wawa, saka ku kira.
S.PHON: anu awa ku ɾimaw isu aka paʦiʦi makətəraw kaʡəmaŋaj wawa saka ku kira
S.FORM: ano awa ko limaw iso, aka pacici maketeraw, ka'emangay wawa, saka ko kira.
S.PHON: an[o|u] awa k[o|u] ɾimaw is[o|u] aka paʦiʦi makətəraw kaʡəmaŋaj wawa saka k[o|u] kira
S.TRANSL: 如果沒有時間不要勉強，妳的小孩會罵。
If you do not have time, we will not force you. Your child will be angry.

S.FORM: u mima'an, haca tu masamatini, awa ku, tatayalen tu masamatini, manga'aytu tayra mifunsia, sa kaku.
S.PHON: u mimaʡan ħaʦa tu masamatini awa ku tatajaɾən tu masamatini maŋaʡajtu tajra mifunsia sa kaku
S.FORM: o mima'an, haca to masamatini, awa ko, tatayalen to masamatini, manga'ayto tayra mifonsia, sa kako.
S.PHON: [o|u] mimaʡan ħaʦa t[o|u] masamatini awa k[o|u] tatajaɾən t[o|u] masamatini maŋaʡajt[o|u] tajra mif[o|u]nsia sa kak[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 這時候有什麼事，沒有什麼要忙的啊，我想還是去噴藥好了。
There is nothing to do. We will go there to spray pesticides.
